*Mentor: Prof. Sandeep Manjanna, Plaksha University.*

Compared physics-informed neural network (PINN) based HJB-PDE solvers against RL algorithms for the inverted pendulum control problem.

- Constructed an inverted pendulum system for hardware testing of policies, achieving under 10 degrees of tracking error with naive PD position control.
- Found that PINN-based controllers yield more optimal solutions, with under 0.002 mean reward deviation from a trajectory-optimization benchmark.
